bibl.title: A History of the Theban Magical Library.
bibl.seg: Korshi Dosoo, A History of the Theban Magical Library.
bibl.note: The Theban Magical Library is recognised as the most important surviving magical archive. Ten magical and alchemical papyri [Greek, Demotic, Old Coptic] can probably be associated with the Theban Library. - Appendix: A Note on Gnostic Cheese [P.G.M. IV, 11-17]. - Addendum.
